name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: West Gondor
storyline:
Call to Minas Tirith: Gondor’s leaders have marched east to prepare for the coming siege, leaving the western lands vulnerable. This absence creates unrest and opens the door for external threats.
Encroaching Invaders: Corsairs and other enemies begin to infiltrate Gondor’s coastal regions, threatening its people and resources.
Your Role: As a hero of Middle-earth, you are summoned by Éowyn at Dunharrow to aid Gondor. Your journey takes you through:

Blackroot Vale – a valley plagued by fear and uncertainty.
Calembel – a Gondorian settlement facing internal strife.
Paths of the Dead – a legendary passage tied to ancient oaths.
Belfalas and Dol Amroth – coastal lands and the majestic city where you help rally defenses.
summary: The West Gondor Quest Pack unlocks the region of Western Gondor, which is designed for characters around level 95. This area is rich in story content and scenic locations, offering players a chance to explore iconic places from Tolkien’s world.
